name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
one_liner: A tool that turns a webpage-style script (HTML and CSS) into an actual downloadable video file, automatically — no camera, no video editor, no manual rendering.
buyer: A marketing ops manager at a SaaS company who needs to auto-generate hundreds of personalized product or usage-recap videos without hiring a video team.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce brand auto-generates a unique product showcase video for every SKU in its catalog by feeding product data into HTML templates.
A SaaS company builds a 'video report' feature that turns a customer's usage stats into a shareable 30-second recap video, like a corporate Spotify Wrapped.
An AI content agency offers 'video-from-brief' as a productized service: clients submit a script, the agency's pipeline (built on this) renders the video same-day.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a hosted 'video-as-a-service' API built on top of this that non-technical marketers can call to turn a data feed into branded videos.
Offer a template marketplace of pre-built HTML video templates (social ads, product demos, recap videos) for agencies to license.

steal_this: Build a weekend tool that takes a company's latest blog post and auto-renders a 20-second animated video summary using one of the pre-built templates, then sell it as a 'blog-to-video' add-on.
